versions.changelog:
le2le-blog-writer v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Generates high-quality Chinese blog articles based on user-provided topics or articles.
- Extracts only core information and rewrites with new logic and structure.
- Produces natural, thoughtful writing without obvious AI patterns.
- Recommended style is rational, engaging, and similar to top Zhihu answers.
- Outputs articles over 800 Chinese characters, directly and without process explanation.
